Sound Machine

Calming noise and ambience, synthesized live in your browser — no audio files, no streaming. Mix several sounds, set a sleep timer, and it keeps playing while the tab is in the background.

😴 Sleep timer

Tip: your mix is remembered on this machine. If you hear nothing, tap ▶ once — browsers require a click before audio can start.

No network — every sound is generated on your machine with the Web Audio API.
